doctrine.objective: Expand territorial control quickly. Every turn prioritize, in order: secure the city you occupy, recruit the largest affordable soldier block, tax, then move toward one reachable unsecured city. Seize and secure cities before the rival does.
doctrine.economy: Spend early income on soldiers. A standing army is the investment; gold left idle is territory forfeited. Never fill the order budget with resource collection: issue at most one Collect or Mine order in a turn, and only when it unlocks an immediate strategic need.
doctrine.risk: Accept moderate losses to secure contested towns. Winning a city at a price beats losing it to the rival.
doctrine.diplomacy: Remain neutral unless attacked. Focus every order on territory, never on gifts, loans or treaties.
